conversion_action.segment_source: Destination settings conversionAction — resource name of the conversion action in Google Ads
conversion_action.rudderstack_source: Destination config conversionAction — resource name of the conversion action in Google Ads
conversion_action.description: The Google Ads conversion action resource name (format: customers/{customerId}/conversionActions/{conversionActionId}). Both platforms derive this from destination configuration. Different events may map to different conversion actions based on event-to-action mapping rules.

gclid_handling.description: Google Click ID (GCLID) is the primary attribution mechanism for Google Ads offline conversion tracking. It links a conversion event back to the specific ad click that initiated the user journey.

gclid.segment_source: properties.gclid or extracted from context.page.url query parameter 'gclid'
gclid.rudderstack_source: properties.gclid or extracted from context.page.url query parameter 'gclid'
gclid.description: Google Click ID for Search and Shopping ads. Required for click-through conversion attribution. Mutually exclusive with gbraid/wbraid at the conversion level.

gbraid.segment_source: properties.gbraid or extracted from context.page.url query parameter 'gbraid'
gbraid.rudderstack_source: properties.gbraid or extracted from context.page.url query parameter 'gbraid'
gbraid.description: Google App campaign attribution identifier used for iOS 14+ campaigns where GCLID is unavailable due to Apple App Tracking Transparency (ATT). Mutually exclusive with gclid.

wbraid.segment_source: properties.wbraid or extracted from context.page.url query parameter 'wbraid'
wbraid.rudderstack_source: properties.wbraid or extracted from context.page.url query parameter 'wbraid'
wbraid.description: Web-to-app attribution identifier for measuring web conversions from iOS 14+ campaigns. Mutually exclusive with gclid.

gclid_handling.click_id_priority: gclid > gbraid > wbraid — only one click identifier should be sent per conversion. GCLID is preferred when available.

conversion_date_time.segment_source: timestamp (ISO 8601 converted to Google Ads format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss+HH:mm)
conversion_date_time.rudderstack_source: timestamp (ISO 8601 converted to Google Ads format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss+HH:mm)
conversion_date_time.transform: Convert ISO 8601 timestamp to Google Ads format: 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss+HH:mm'
conversion_date_time.description: Conversion timestamp in the Google Ads required format. Must include timezone offset. Both platforms must apply the same timestamp format conversion from ISO 8601.

conversion_value.transform: Numeric value; defaults to 0 if not provided
conversion_value.description: Monetary value of the conversion. Both platforms extract from revenue/value/total properties. Required for value-based bidding strategies in Google Ads.

currency_code.segment_source: properties.currency or default from destination settings
currency_code.rudderstack_source: properties.currency or default from destination config
currency_code.description: Currency code for the conversion value. Defaults to destination-level configuration if not provided per-event.

order_id.description: Order ID used for conversion deduplication in Google Ads. If the same orderId is uploaded multiple times for the same conversionAction, Google Ads counts it as a single conversion.

conversion_environment.description: Specifies the environment where the conversion occurred. Defaults to UNSPECIFIED.

partial_failure.description: When true, operations that fail individually do not cause the entire request to fail. Both platforms should set this to true for reliable batch upload.

user_identification.description: Enhanced Conversions use hashed first-party user data to improve conversion attribution. All PII fields must be SHA-256 hashed after normalization (lowercase, trimming whitespace) before transmission.

email.transform: Lowercase, trim whitespace, remove dots from gmail local part, SHA-256 hash
email.description: Email address is normalized (lowercased, trimmed) and SHA-256 hashed. Google Ads requires pre-hashed values for Enhanced Conversions.

phone_number.transform: Convert to E.164 format, SHA-256 hash
phone_number.description: Phone number is normalized to E.164 format (with country code prefix) and SHA-256 hashed before sending to Google Ads.

first_name.description: First name is lowercased, trimmed, and SHA-256 hashed as part of address-based user identification.

last_name.description: Last name is lowercased, trimmed, and SHA-256 hashed as part of address-based user identification.

street_address.description: Street address is lowercased, trimmed, and SHA-256 hashed.

city.description: City name is sent in plain text as part of address-based user identification.

state.description: State or province code sent in plain text.

postal_code.description: Postal/ZIP code sent in plain text.

country.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format. Mapped from traits.address.country.

remarketing_list_mapping.description: Customer Match / Remarketing list uploads use the OfflineUserDataJob API to add or remove users from audience lists in Google Ads for retargeting campaigns.

user_list.segment_source: Destination settings userListId — resource name of the Customer Match user list
user_list.rudderstack_source: Destination config userListId — resource name of the Customer Match user list
user_list.description: Resource name of the Customer Match user list (format: customers/{customerId}/userLists/{userListId}). Configured per destination.

operation_type.segment_source: Derived from event type: track 'Audience Entered' → create; track 'Audience Exited' → remove
operation_type.rudderstack_source: Derived from event type: track 'Audience Entered' → create; track 'Audience Exited' → remove
operation_type.description: The operation type determines whether users are added to or removed from the audience list.

user_identifiers.description: Same hashing and normalization rules as Enhanced Conversions user identifiers apply. Customer Match supports hashedEmail, hashedPhoneNumber, and addressInfo.
user_identifiers.transform: Same SHA-256 hashing with normalization as conversion user identifiers

event_name_mapping.description: Maps Segment/RudderStack standard event names to Google Ads conversion action names. The mapping is typically configured at the destination level, not hardcoded.
event_name_mapping.custom_events: Non-standard event names can be mapped to custom conversion actions configured in Google Ads Manager via the destination configuration mapping.

customer_id.transform: Remove dashes from the formatted customer ID (e.g., '123-456-7890' → '1234567890')
customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID used in the API URL path. Must be numeric without dashes.

developer_token.description: Developer token for API access, sent as an HTTP header.

login_customer_id.segment_source: Destination settings loginCustomerId (optional, for MCC accounts)
login_customer_id.rudderstack_source: Destination config loginCustomerId (optional, for MCC accounts)
login_customer_id.description: Manager account (MCC) customer ID. Required only when making API calls on behalf of a sub-account through a manager account.

known_differences.description: Segment uses 'analytics.js'; RudderStack uses 'rudder-sdk-js'. This field is in the input event and does not affect the Google Ads output payload.
known_differences.impact: No impact — library metadata is not forwarded to Google Ads.

known_differences.description: RudderStack input events include additional fields: rudderId, originalTimestamp, sentAt, receivedAt. These are RudderStack-specific envelope fields not present in Segment events.
known_differences.impact: No impact — these envelope fields are not forwarded to Google Ads.

known_differences.description: Segment and RudderStack generate messageId values using different UUID strategies. messageId is not directly sent to Google Ads but may be used internally for deduplication.
known_differences.impact: Minimal — Google Ads uses orderId for deduplication, not messageId.

known_differences.description: Both platforms extract GCLID from properties.gclid or from the page URL query parameter. Verify that URL parsing logic handles edge cases identically (encoded characters, missing parameter, fragment vs query).
known_differences.impact: Missing or incorrect GCLID would break conversion attribution entirely. This is the most critical parity field.

known_differences.description: Google Ads requires timestamps in 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss+HH:mm' format. Both platforms must convert ISO 8601 timestamps identically. Verify timezone handling, especially for UTC offsets.
known_differences.impact: Incorrect timestamp format causes the Google Ads API to reject the conversion upload.

known_differences.description: Both platforms should SHA-256 hash email, phone, firstName, lastName, and streetAddress. Verify identical normalization steps: lowercasing, whitespace trimming, E.164 phone formatting, and gmail dot-stripping.
known_differences.impact: Different normalization produces different hashes, reducing Enhanced Conversion match rates and reporting accuracy.

known_differences.description: Both platforms should map properties.revenue, properties.value, or properties.total to conversionValue. Verify the priority/fallback order is identical.
known_differences.impact: Different revenue field priority could cause incorrect conversion values, affecting value-based bidding strategies.

known_differences.description: Segment's Google Ads Enhanced Conversions destination uses the Actions-based architecture with configurable field mappings and event subscriptions. RudderStack uses a fixed Transformer-based mapping. The underlying Google Ads API calls should be equivalent, but Segment's Actions allow more user customization.
known_differences.impact: Functional parity in default configuration, but Segment users with custom action mappings may see different behavior.

validation_requirements: Verify conversionAction resource name is correctly derived from destination configuration
Verify GCLID extraction from properties.gclid and from page URL query parameter 'gclid' matches Segment behavior
Verify gbraid and wbraid extraction for iOS 14+ attribution matches Segment behavior
Verify conversionDateTime format conversion from ISO 8601 to Google Ads format ('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss+HH:mm') handles timezones correctly
Verify conversionValue correctly maps from properties.revenue / properties.value / properties.total with identical fallback priority
Verify currencyCode defaults to destination-level configuration when not provided per-event
Verify orderId is forwarded for deduplication when available
Verify PII fields (email, phone, firstName, lastName, streetAddress) are SHA-256 hashed with identical normalization (lowercase, trim, E.164 phone, gmail dot-stripping)
Verify addressInfo fields (city, state, postalCode, countryCode) are sent in plain text (not hashed)
Verify Customer Match remarketing list uploads use correct OfflineUserDataJob API format
Verify customer ID is formatted without dashes in the API URL path
Verify login-customer-id header is sent only when configured for MCC accounts
Verify partialFailure is set to true in all conversion upload requests
Verify conversionEnvironment enum value is correctly passed (UNSPECIFIED, APP, WEB)
Verify custom (non-standard) event names are mapped to configured conversion actions

notes: Google Ads is a shared cloud destination in the Advertising category. RudderStack delivers Google Ads via the Router as a cloud REST destination using the Google Ads API v16 (Conversion Upload and Customer Match endpoints). Segment has an Actions-based variant (actions-google-enhanced-conversions) with configurable field mappings. The primary integration pattern is offline conversion tracking via the uploadClickConversions endpoint, which requires GCLID-based attribution and supports Enhanced Conversions with hashed first-party user data. A secondary integration pattern supports Customer Match remarketing list uploads via the OfflineUserDataJob API for audience retargeting. Key parity focus areas: GCLID/gbraid/wbraid extraction and forwarding, conversion timestamp format conversion, PII normalization and SHA-256 hashing for Enhanced Conversions, conversion value and currency mapping, and order ID deduplication. The Google Ads Conversion API is the most critical advertising integration for attributing offline conversions to Google Ads campaigns.
